body:
# Iker's Tube 1.0.0

Iker's Tube is a YouTube client for the Nintendo 3DS family, built on top of FourthTube and ThirdTube (GPLv3).

## Highlights

- **Smooth playback.** A sliding-window buffer keeps the video downloading ahead of you using the SD card, drops what is behind, and retries on network errors instead of freezing.
- **Resilient playback.** If one playback client stops working, the app tries the others automatically.
- **Library.** A play queue you can reorder, favorites, and named playlists with play, shuffle and repeat. Long press a video anywhere to queue it.
- **Smarter search.** Recent searches and filters for type, date and duration.
- **Continue where you left off.** Videos resume from the minute you stopped.
- **Sleep timer, speed and pitch controls, and an audio/video sync adjustment** in the player.
- **Automatic updates.** Stable releases install themselves when the app starts; development builds are only offered, and you decide.
- **New look.** Dark theme with a red accent, animated menu and thumbnails that fade in.

## Installing

Install `IkersTube.cia` with FBI, or run `IkersTube.3dsx` from the Homebrew Launcher.
The DSP firmware dump (`sdmc:/3ds/dspfirm.cdc`) is needed for sound.

body:
# Iker's Tube 1.0.2

Iker's Tube is a YouTube client for the Nintendo 3DS family, built on top of FourthTube and ThirdTube (GPLv3).

## What's new since 1.0.1

### Your YouTube account (OAuth login needed)
- **Like or dislike a video**, **save it to your YouTube playlists**, and **subscribe or unsubscribe** on your account (the subscribe button now also updates your account).
- **Comments.** Write a comment, and long press a comment to like it, reply to it or translate it.
- **Your account in Search.** Recommended videos and your notifications inbox, and the Later tab also downloads your YouTube Watch later playlist.

### Player
- **Mini player** with big controls on the bottom screen, swipe gestures, volume remembered per channel and a left-handed mode.
- **Tools on the video page.** Jump 10 s back or forward, skip 30 s, A-B loop, tappable chapters, bookmarks with names, next chapter, quick speed (50% to 200%, remembered per channel), stop after this video and a premiere countdown.
- **Seek preview** thumbnails while dragging the progress bar, equalizer presets and sound profiles (music, movie, speech).
- **Shorts play one after another** when opened from a channel.
- **Buttons.** Choose what X, Y, L and R do in the player.
- **Starts at the beginning.** A new video no longer starts at the minute of the previous one. A Settings option makes every video start from the beginning.
- **Screensaver.** The logo bounces on a black top screen after a minute of pause.

### Studio
- **Studio tab** next to Home, Subscribed and New: your subscribers, total views and total videos, and upload a video or a Short from any folder of the SD card with title, description and visibility. Needs the OAuth login.

### Library and search
- **Library.** Queue, favorites with tags, playlists, Watch later and the new Offline tab. Sort and filter favorites and Watch later, play next from any list and a check mark on videos you already watched.
- **Offline audio.** Save the audio of a video to the SD card and play it without a connection.
- **Search.** Keyboard suggestions, Explore and Discover shortcuts, continue watching the last video, QR scanning with the camera and a red dot when your subscriptions have new videos.
- **Grid of thumbnails** in search, channels and the home feed (optional).
- **Translate** a video title and description, or a comment, into the language of the app.
- **QR codes** of any video (including the current moment), also from the queue, favorites and playlists.

### Look and settings
- **Themes.** Six themes plus a custom color, a high contrast mode, text size, large thumbnails and an optional background picture from the SD card.
- **Settings in sections** with a start screen, automatic theme by time of day, data saver, a data limit warning, statistics, backup export and import, and the first launch opens the settings.
- **Languages.** All the new texts are available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Japanese.

### Reliability
- **Fixes.** Videos over an hour with a single combined stream play again, the A-B loop no longer freezes, comment sorting no longer crashes, and many cases that could close the app were fixed after a full code review.
- **Network.** Failed host name lookups right after the Wi-Fi connects are retried and the app asks the console to reconnect if the Wi-Fi drops during playback.
- **Diagnostics.** Warnings and errors are saved to sdmc:/3ds/IkersTube/log.txt, and an unexpected abort writes sdmc:/3ds/IkersTube/crash.txt.

## Installing

Install `IkersTube.cia` with FBI, or run `IkersTube.3dsx` from the Homebrew Launcher.
The DSP firmware dump (`sdmc:/3ds/dspfirm.cdc`) is needed for sound.

name: Iker's Tube 1.0.3
body:
# Iker's Tube 1.0.3

Iker's Tube is a YouTube client for the Nintendo 3DS family, built on top of FourthTube and ThirdTube (GPLv3).

## What's new since 1.0.2

### Offline
- **Offline videos.** The Save video button saves a video on the SD card (360p, 240p on the old 3DS) next to the old Save audio. Saved videos play without any connection from the Offline list.
- **Save offline from lists.** Long press a video in Favorites, Watch later, a playlist or the queue to save its video or audio. The app loads it in the background.
- **Download queue.** Several downloads can be queued. The Downloads screen shows the progress, how many are waiting and lets you cancel.
- **Downloads screen.** Items saved, space used and free on the SD card, and Play all / Shuffle for everything you saved.
- **Sort and search downloads** by newest, title or size, or by text, and the video page shows when a video is already saved.
- **Clean up.** An optional setting deletes a download after you watch it, and a button deletes all downloads (with confirmation).
- **Resilient downloads.** A Wi-Fi hiccup is retried instead of failing the whole download.
- **Download indicator.** A green dot on Downloads while something downloads.
- **Saved copies.** A DL tag marks the videos that are saved, and without internet opening one of them plays the saved copy.
- **No connection strip.** A red strip says when the console has no internet and reminds that saved downloads still play.

### New look
- **Bottom navigation bar** with icons (Home, Search, Library, Downloads, More) on the main screens.
- **Pill tabs** in the accent color and rounded buttons.
- **Start screen.** A loading screen with a progress bar from the first moment, kept for 3 seconds at the end so the account and data load (the .cia now carries the real Homebrew logo animation instead of the old FourthTube one; the HOME Menu plays it before the app).

### Studio
- **Statistics kept.** The last numbers are saved and shown when they cannot be loaded.
- **Statistics fixed.** Subscribers, total views and total videos come from the public About page of your channel, so they load without the Data API.
- **Own Studio login.** Uploading and editing need the YouTube Data API, which the main login cannot use. Studio has its own sign-in with a Google Cloud client of yours, built into the app by the build secrets or set up in the Studio tab with a QR or by typing (see Documentation/STUDIO_SETUP.md).
- **Upload with more options.** Category and custom thumbnail, a button to watch the uploaded video, and uploads run in their own network session.
- **Video numbers.** Opening one of your uploads shows its views, likes and comments.
- **Resume uploads and tags.** An interrupted upload can be continued later, and the upload form has tags.
- **Edit my uploads.** Change visibility, title, delete, or watch your latest uploads (without the Studio login it lists your public videos). Create playlists and open your channel.

### Comments and player
- **Autoplay countdown.** An optional wait (3, 5 or 10 s) with a countdown before the next video, cancelled with A.
- **Collaboration videos.** Tap the author of a video with several channels to see all of them (icon, handle, subscribers), open any, or long press one to subscribe.
- **Comments.** Sending, replying and liking try several YouTube clients, and a failure now shows the reason on screen. Pinned and creator-hearted comments are marked.
- **SponsorBlock.** An optional setting skips the parts of a video that the community marked as sponsors (or also self promotion, intros and outros).
- **Volume and brightness buttons.** X, Y, L and R can be set to volume +/- and brightness +/-.
- **Own comments.** Delete your own comments, and like or reply on comments of any page (best effort).
- **Chapters** show as ticks on the buffering bar, and the last subtitle language is preselected.

### Library and reliability
- **Continue watching.** The first item of Home is the last video you played.
- **First-use tour and error report.** A short tour on first use, and Create a report to send in Settings (one file with version, state and log).
- **Thumbnail cache on the SD card.** Pictures already seen show at once and use no data.
- **Queue and backups.** The play queue survives a restart, your data is backed up on the SD card once a week, and the app tells you when the last run ended in a crash.
- **Incognito mode.** From the More menu or Settings: no history, searches, resume points or last video are remembered.
- **Search.** More Explore shortcuts (Shorts, Learn something, Funny), long press a recent search to forget it, and optional settings hide Shorts and already watched videos in search, home and the subscription feeds.
- **Fixes from three code reviews.** A failed re-download no longer deletes a saved copy, saved videos with one file can play as audio, the bottom bar no longer piles up screens, the crash notice stays visible, comment details are shared safely between threads, Failed download threads no longer block later downloads, popups no longer leak on every visit, a failed read of an offline file no longer breaks playback, and uploads no longer clash with other network requests.
- **Bell, Not interested, Hide channel.** New video tools when signed in: per-channel notification level, and telling YouTube to stop recommending a video or channel.
- **Scheduled publishing.** Studio upload has Publish: now, 1 hour, 3 hours, 1 day, 3 days or 1 week; the time comes from the internet (the console clock has no reliable time zone).

## Installing

Install `IkersTube.cia` with FBI, or run `IkersTube.3dsx` from the Homebrew Launcher.
The DSP firmware dump (`sdmc:/3ds/dspfirm.cdc`) is needed for sound.

---

name: Iker's Tube 1.0.4
body:
# Iker's Tube 1.0.4

Iker's Tube is a YouTube client for the Nintendo 3DS family, built on top of FourthTube and ThirdTube (GPLv3).

## What's new since 1.0.3

### Account and YouTube
- **History.** Videos you watch while signed in (not in incognito) are reported to your YouTube history.
- **Liked tab.** The Library shows the videos you liked on YouTube.
- **Queue and lists to YouTube.** Save the play queue or one of your local lists as a private playlist of your account.
- **Subscribe from the channel page.** It now also subscribes on your YouTube account.
- **Live and upcoming in the feed.** The subscriptions feed puts live streams first, then upcoming premieres with the time left, and warns when one starts within 15 minutes.
- **Comments.** Without a comments token (comments not opened) writing and replying now work, and when a comment or chat message fails a screen shows the whole reason. With the Studio login the Data API is tried first (YouTube may refuse it for lack of scopes, then the old way is used). Liking a video falls back to the Data API too.

### Player
- **Live chat.** Read the chat of a live stream from the player tools (Super Chats included, Top chat or All chat), and write in it with the Studio login.
- **Audio language and links.** Choose the dubbed audio of videos that have several tracks (the full list is asked to the ANDROID client), and open the links of the description through a QR code.
- **Quick sleep timer.** A Sleep timer button in the player tools.
- **Collaboration screen.** Channels are cards, three per page with a More button, so nothing is drawn outside the screen, and a Subscribe all button follows every channel of the video.
- **Live chat fits.** It shows the newest messages that fit above its buttons.

### Library, settings and look
- **Podcasts, Courses and Releases.** Channels that have those tabs show them as categories of the Playlists tab.
- **Shorts feed.** The Shorts shortcut in Explore plays the whole list one after another in a shuffled loop.
- **Night downloads.** A setting makes the downloads wait for the hours 1:00 to 7:00.
- **Usage statistics.** Settings, Data shows how many videos you watched, about how many hours and your top three channels.
- **Hide the Studio tab.** A setting removes the Studio tab from the Home screen.
- **More modern look.** Rounded and spaced player buttons, accent popup titles, rounded dialogs and buttons, channel cards and the six Library tabs across the whole width.
- **Studio login.** It now shows the address and the code on separate lines so the code is never cut off.
- **Channel QR.** The Info tab of a channel has a QR code button.
- **Your YouTube lists in the Library.** The Liked tab cycles through your liked videos, your YouTube history and each playlist of your account (best effort).
- **Comment diagnostics.** When comments cannot be sent, the failure screen lists what YouTube answered, and new comments and replies have a last-resort way to be sent.
- **Bulk actions in the Library.** Play all, Shuffle and Save audio on Favorites, Watch later and Liked; Shuffle queue and Save all audio on the queue.
- **Play or queue a whole search or channel.** Play all and Queue all at the top of the results and of the Videos tab of a channel.
- **Watch later cleanup and player buttons.** An option removes a video from Watch later when you finish it; the player has Next video, Mute, -1 min and +1 min.
- **Free room.** Delete the downloads you already watched, and clear the picture cache.
- **Video actions menu everywhere.** Long press a video in any list to play it next, queue it, save it to Watch later or Favorites, download it, say Not interested, add it to a YouTube playlist, or search similar videos.
- **Default speed.** A setting for the playback speed of channels without their own.
- **Save a whole playlist.** A player tool downloads the audio of the playlist the video is in.
- **History as a playlist.** Play all, Shuffle and a text search on the History screen, and the full video menu on long press.
- **Channel menu.** Long press a channel in the search results to subscribe or set the bell.
- **Upload to a playlist.** The Studio upload form can add the new video to one of your playlists.
- **Edit the description** of your uploads from Studio.
- **More search filters.** Live now, Playlists, Channels, Last hour, This year, sort by date or views, and HD.
- **Progress bars and day headers.** Started videos show a red progress bar on their thumbnail, and the History is grouped by day.
- **Explore shortcuts and queue preview.** Eight more Explore topics, and the player shows the next video of the queue.
- **Auto chat.** A setting opens the live chat by itself when a live stream plays; the player also has a Restart tool, and the channel Videos row can save audio.
- **Saved video quality.** A setting chooses 144p, 240p or 360p for the videos you save, and the video menu can mark videos as watched.
- **Reset the settings** from Settings, Data (lists, history and downloads are kept).
- **Autoplay skips watched.** A setting makes autoplay avoid the videos already in your history.
- **Hide channels in lists.** Choose channels whose videos never show in search, Home or the feeds (Settings, Data lists how many and shows them again).
- **Links with a time.** A YouTube link with &t= or &start= starts the video at that moment.
- **Lists.** Rename local lists, save the queue as a list, remove watched videos from the queue and Watch later, and a What is new dialog after an update.
- **Recent channels** in Search, plus player tools Info, Loop, Mute and Shuffle playlist.

## Installing

Install `IkersTube.cia` with FBI, or run `IkersTube.3dsx` from the Homebrew Launcher.
The DSP firmware dump (`sdmc:/3ds/dspfirm.cdc`) is needed for sound.
- Player: "CC" tool to turn YouTube subtitles on and cycle their languages; "<< Chap" tool for the previous chapter.

# Iker's Tube 1.0.5

Iker's Tube is a YouTube client for the Nintendo 3DS family, built on top of FourthTube and ThirdTube (GPLv3).

## What's new since 1.0.4

### Player
- **Subtitles.** New "CC" tool turns YouTube subtitles on and cycles their languages, with a last step that translates them to the language of the app. A setting (Subtitles, Open by itself) turns on the language you used last time automatically.
- **Audio tracks.** Dubbed audio tracks are now found by parsing the YouTube answer properly and trying two clients. If a video still shows one track, the notice and report.txt say what YouTube returned.
- **New tools.** Video QR (QR code of the video link), "<< Chap" (previous chapter), -5 min and +5 min, and Reload (reloads the video from the same minute).
- **Shorts.** The Shorts shortcut opens the first Short at once and tries YouTube's real Shorts feed (experimental). D-pad Down and Up in the player go to the next and the previous video.

### Search and library
- **More search filters.** Subtitles (CC), Creative Commons, 4K, HDR and 360 degrees.
- **Search suggestions.** The keyboard offers YouTube autocomplete suggestions while you type.
- **More from this channel.** New option in the long press menu of a video.
- **Manage your YouTube lists.** Rename or delete your own playlists from the Library (Liked tab).

### Channels and account
- **Bell on the channel page.** The Info tab of a channel changes its notification level.
- **Community posts.** Long press a post to like it or vote in its poll (experimental).

## Installing

Install `IkersTube.cia` with FBI, or run `IkersTube.3dsx` from the Homebrew Launcher.
The DSP firmware dump (`sdmc:/3ds/dspfirm.cdc`) is needed for sound.

name: Iker's Tube 1.0.6
body:
# Iker's Tube 1.0.6

Iker's Tube is a YouTube client for the Nintendo 3DS family, built on top of FourthTube and ThirdTube (GPLv3).

## What's new since 1.0.5

### Player
- **Subtitle tools.** CC size and CC color change the subtitles on the spot. The Info tool also lists the subtitle languages and chapters.
- **More tools.** Video QR is joined by QR at this time, Autoplay (off, list, all), Slower and Faster (5% steps), Hashtags (searches the tags of a video), +List (adds the video to a local playlist), Shuffle queue, Mark watched, Save list to YouTube, Screens off (listen with the screens dark; SELECT + START brings them back) and Status (clock and battery).
- **Chapters.** The chapter tools show the name of the chapter they jump to, and the chapter list highlights the one that is playing.
- **Seek step.** A setting chooses how many seconds the D-pad left and right jump (5, 10, 15 or 30).
- **Time left.** A setting makes the player bar show the time left instead of the length.
- **Videos in a row and break reminder.** Settings stop the queue and autoplay after 3, 5 or 10 videos (good to fall asleep) and remind you to take a break after 30, 60 or 120 minutes.
- **Battery.** The player warns at 15% and 5% battery.
- **Reload comments.** A Reload button in the Comments tab shows the comment you just sent. The comment keyboard offers quick phrases (your own in comment_phrases.txt).
- **Suggestions.** The Suggestions tab respects hidden channels and the hide settings.

### Search and menus
- **Combinable search filters.** The Filter button opens menus (sort, upload date, type, length, features) that can be combined. Medium (4-20 min) is new and the length filters now use the right YouTube values.
- **Related searches and tips.** The results show four related searches to tap. The start page shows a tip of the day and a Surprise me (random topic) button, plus seven more Explore shortcuts.
- **Menus.** The long press menus use pages (More options, Previous options) so all the options fit on the screen. A video can be liked on YouTube or added to a local playlist from its menu, and Forget where I stopped is there too.

### Library, history and channels
- **Library.** It opens on the tab you used last. Queue: Remove duplicates. Favorites and Watch later can be cleared (it asks first). Liked: remove your like. Downloads: sort by channel and a QR code option.
- **History.** Top channels lists the channels you watch most; long press a day header to delete that whole day.
- **Pinned channels.** Pin your favorite subscribed channels on top of the channels list.
- **Channel page.** Shuffle and Surprise me buttons for the videos of a channel.
- **Hidden channels.** A list shows them again one by one or all at once.

### Data, Studio and system
- **Import and export.** Export lists also writes your subscriptions as a CSV (local and account channels) and every local playlist as a text file. Import subscriptions reads import_subscriptions.csv.
- **Resume positions.** A Data button forgets where you stopped in the videos.
- **Studio.** The upload picker has a shortcut to the 3DS camera videos (DCIM) and upload_description.txt and upload_tags.txt fill the form of every new upload.
- **About and updates.** Tap the GitHub address to see its QR code. The update check uses the current repository address directly. The report has more facts to help with problems.

### Subtitles, audio tracks, Shorts and the account (carried over from the devbuilds)
- **Subtitles.** The CC tool turns on YouTube subtitles, cycles their languages and has a last step that translates them to the language of the app. A setting turns on the language you used last automatically.
- **Audio tracks.** Dubbed tracks are found by parsing the YouTube answer properly and trying two clients; report.txt says what the probe saw.
- **Shorts.** The Shorts shortcut opens the first Short at once and tries YouTube's real Shorts feed (experimental). D-pad Down and Up in the player go to the next and the previous video.
- **Account.** Rename or delete your own YouTube playlists in the Library, save a playlist you watch to your YouTube library, and long press a community post to like it or vote in its poll (experimental). A Bell button on the channel page changes its notification level.
- **Mark watched.** New player tool adds or removes the video in the history by hand.

## Installing

Install `IkersTube.cia` with FBI, or run `IkersTube.3dsx` from the Homebrew Launcher.
The DSP firmware dump (`sdmc:/3ds/dspfirm.cdc`) is needed for sound.

name: Iker's Tube 1.0.7
body:
# Iker's Tube 1.0.7

Iker's Tube is a YouTube client for the Nintendo 3DS family, built on top of FourthTube and ThirdTube (GPLv3).

## What's new since 1.0.6

### Fixes (important)
- **Crash at startup.** Some consoles crashed every time the app opened after the update to 1.0.6. The background fetch of the keyboard suggestions no longer uses its own thread or network sessions (it runs in the async worker, once Search is opened), which removes a race that could crash the app while the home feed was loading.
- **Safe mode.** If a start does not finish (a crash), the next start renames the settings and the optional files to *.crashed (nothing is deleted, existing copies are never overwritten), skips the dialogs and the background extras and says so with a notice. The start counts as good after 30 seconds of running or on a normal exit.
- If 1.0.6 crashes on your console and the app cannot update itself: delete or rename 3ds/IkersTube/settings.txt on the SD card, or install this version with FBI.

### Changes
- **Rounded buttons.** Buttons have rounded corners (a setting turns it off).
- **My Wrapped.** A summary of what you watch: top channel, favorite hour, streak and more.
- **Sleep timer fade.** The volume goes down smoothly during the last 30 seconds of the sleep timer.
- **Next episode.** New player tool finds the next episode of a series by number.
- **Radio.** Eight mood mixes (Chill, Focus, Workout, Sleep...) that keep playing by themselves.
- **Notices.** The notices are rounded, fit their text, slide in and fade out.
- **New videos notice.** Once per session the app tells how many new videos your channels have.
- **Bookmarks.** Long press a bookmark for its QR code or to delete it.
- **Data saver tool.** Turn the data saver on or off from the player.
- **Greeting.** The start page of Search greets you by the time of the day.
- **Rounded badges.** The badges on the thumbnails are rounded.
- **Daily limit.** A setting warns when you reach 30, 60, 120 or 240 minutes of playing in a day.
- **Rounded selectors.** The selectors have a soft track and a rounded pill.
- **Safe mode.** If the app crashes while starting, the next start sets the settings aside and starts without extras instead of crashing again.

## Installing

Install `IkersTube.cia` with FBI, or run `IkersTube.3dsx` from the Homebrew Launcher.
The DSP firmware dump (`sdmc:/3ds/dspfirm.cdc`) is needed for sound.
